name: io.github.markusvankempen/literature-clock-mcp
title: Literature Clock
description: A line for the current minute, from literature, copyright-free books, or an original voice.

environmentVariables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the Settings and Log pages. Required when HOST is 0.0.0.0 or the process runs in a container. Laptop default is demo until this is set.

environmentVariables.name: ADMIN_USER
environmentVariables.description: Sign-in name for Settings. Default demo.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for tool calls when AUTH_MODE is write or all. Issue one on /admin.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: off (default), write, or all. describe_server stays open in every mode.

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Max tool calls per window per caller. Default 60.
